01-search.title: Search for papers
01-search.subtitle: Search OpenAlex by topic. Each result shows its authors, year, abstract and links.

02-save.title: Save a paper
02-save.subtitle: It joins your library, and its PDF is fetched from OpenAlex automatically.

03-attach.title: No stored copy? Upload the PDF
03-attach.subtitle: OpenAlex has no copy of this SoK, so we attach the PDF from arXiv.

04-upload.title: Upload a PDF
04-upload.subtitle: The title and authors are read from the PDF, then matched to the full OpenAlex record.

05-summary.title: Summarize a paper
05-summary.subtitle: Written from the paper’s full text, with page citations you can check.

06-ask.title: Ask about a paper
06-ask.subtitle: Answers cite their pages. Click a citation to see the passage.

07-multi.title: Ask across papers
07-multi.subtitle: Mention papers with @ to compare them in one conversation.

08-library.title: Your library stays
08-library.subtitle: Still there after restarting the app. Filter it, edit details and reopen chats.

09-settings.title: Settings
09-settings.subtitle: Theme, default model and reasoning, search index and where paper details come from.
